description: WRaINfo processes observations from FURUNO X-band weather radars for quantitative rainfall analysis. FERN.Lab at GFZ provides Python routines built on wradlib for clutter removal, attenuation correction, rainfall estimation, georeferencing and gridding. The paper identifies WR2120 and WR2100 devices; the package documentation describes NetCDF outputs using a selected coordinate reference system. Spatial coverage and integration intervals follow the radar and its scan settings. These precipitation fields can supply forcing or checks for drainage and flood simulations. Code is free under Apache-2.0 and the public package registry links its source and documentation. The related Neubrandenburg radar observations have separate CC-BY-NC-4.0 terms, which do not change the software licence. A limitation is that radar corrections and reflectivity-to-rainfall assumptions require local assessment. No radar payload was downloaded and no processing output was compared against gauges.
name: WRaINfo FURUNO radar processing
